# Lanesra OS

Lanesra OS is a free, open-source, self-hostable, AI-native business application platform for small and mid-size organizations. It leads with an AI Agent Foundry and Unified AI Gateway where named AI agents run directly against your real data, not a bolted-on chatbot with a separate context pipeline, and a native MCP server & CLI that expose that same data to Claude Desktop, an IDE agent or any MCP-capable client. Both sit on the same no-code platform for building whatever a business actually needs, which also powers a complete CRM out of the box — your Business OS — and an Industry Data Model of 10 ready-made industry apps to install instead of building from scratch. Deployment Management packages and promotes customizations across environments, and an Integration Hub connects it to every other system a business already runs.

## What it is, in seven layers

1. **AI Agent Foundry** — a Unified AI Gateway (bring your own Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible/Google Gemini key, or route to a fully local/air-gapped model via Ollama, with automatic failover and per-agent/per-workspace token budgets), named agents with a persona, a per-tool Actions checklist, persistent Memory, a shared Skills library, and delegation, Orchestration (deterministic Pipelines, schedule/webhook/workflow-fired runs), a conversational Chat Assistant with real tool access, and a Context Layer with ranked full-text search and embeddings-based Vector Search over records — every agent runs directly against the same Core CRM/Custom Object data model below, no separate context pipeline.
2. **MCP** — a native Model Context Protocol server (`POST /mcp`, JSON-RPC 2.0) exposing that same data and business logic to Claude Desktop, an IDE agent, or any MCP-capable client, plus a companion CLI giving humans and shell scripts the same REST API access without an agent in the loop — both authenticated with the same scoped API keys the REST API already uses.
3. **No-code platform primitives** — Custom Objects (entirely new record types, no code), Custom Relationships (any two record types, any cardinality), Screen/App Builder (named layouts by role, Draft → Publish), Business Rules (multi-condition AND/OR, 10 operators), Workflow Automation (7 trigger types, 8+ action types), custom Dashboards and Reports. An Administrator reshapes the workspace from a settings screen — no developer required. Both the AI Agent Foundry above and the Core CRM below are built on this same layer.
4. **Core CRM** — Companies, Contacts, Opportunities, Products, Quotes, Orders, Invoices, Contracts and Tasks, connected in one flexible sales lifecycle (Company → Opportunity → Quote → Order → Invoice), with dashboards, reports and global search.
5. **Industry Data Model** — a versioned package manifest format (objects, fields, relationships, rules, workflows, screens, reports and a dashboard) installed into an existing workspace, reusing its existing Company/Contact/Task core rather than creating a parallel data model; 10 ready-made industry apps (Field Service, Property Management, Construction & Contractors, Professional Services, Practice Administration, Recruitment & Staffing, Real Estate Brokerage, Legal Practice, Nonprofit & Association Management, Auto Repair & Service Garage) install in a few clicks, each validated, backed up and installed transactionally. A plain App Builder (part of the no-code layer above) still groups any hand-built set of objects into your own named, publishable app with role/user-based access.
6. **Deployment Management** — a Publisher registry with namespace validation, named/versioned Solutions (a curated subset of components), export/import between workspaces, and update-with-diff for reviewing and applying a newer package version — the same "build in test, promote to production" pattern enterprise platforms use, without enterprise licensing.
7. **Integration Hub** — encrypted Connections (REST, SFTP, PostgreSQL, OData, SMTP), OpenAPI-imported Connectors usable as Workflow Automation actions, a generic REST API with hashed/scoped API keys, HMAC-signed outbound Webhooks with retry, a CSV data-exchange wizard, read-only External Objects, and scheduled Integration Jobs for recurring sync — desktop-only today.

## Current status

- Early Access — the desktop app itself is at v0.12.0; the website/product tracks a separate sequential version counter, now at v0.45.0
- Windows desktop edition (Tauri + Rust + SQLite): the full sales lifecycle, Contracts, Tasks, user management, Team Workspace mode for small teams (Docker), backup/restore, self-service password change, PDF generation/printing, and CSV import/export all working. desktop-v0.12.0 is the latest tagged Early Access Windows installer (.exe/.msi) on GitHub Releases (unsigned); build and run from source is also supported.
- No-code platform (desktop and demo): Custom Objects, Custom Relationships, Screen/App Builder, Business Rules, Workflow Automation, Dashboards, Reports, global search, Saved Views & Bulk Actions.
- App Catalog (desktop and demo): all 10 industry reference packages install transactionally into an existing workspace.
- Deployment Management (desktop and demo): Publishers, versioned Solutions, real export/import, update-with-diff.
- Integration Hub (desktop only, real): AES-256-GCM-encrypted Connections, OpenAPI Connector import, a generic REST API secured by hashed scoped API keys, HMAC-signed Webhooks, a CSV data-exchange wizard, External Objects, and a real background-scheduled Integration Jobs engine on the Team Workspace server. The online demo simulates this layer client-side (no server to make a real call from).
- AI & Agentic Layer (desktop and demo): a native MCP server & CLI, a Chat Assistant, the AI Agent Foundry (named agents with persona, Actions, Memory, Skills, delegation), Orchestration (Pipelines/Triggers/workflow-fired runs, with human-approval gates on any topology's own resume point), and a Unified AI Gateway (multi-provider routing, failover, token budgets, DLP air-gapping) are all shipped. A Context Layer adds ranked full-text search over Custom Object records (SQLite FTS5/`bm25()` — lexical relevance) and real change-history for every agent's Memory; Vector Search (desktop only, opt-in) adds a second, meaning-based ranking on top - real embeddings from the workspace's own already-configured OpenAI-compatible/Gemini provider, stored as plain SQLite BLOBs and compared by cosine similarity in Rust, not a bundled vector database.
- Team Workspace server: can be exposed on the open internet on an organization's own domain (still self-hosted, never a Lanesra-run SaaS), with opt-in TLS-aware cookies, CORS and always-on security headers.

## Core capabilities

- AI Agent Foundry: named agents with persona, Actions, Memory (with real change history), Skills, guardrails, and delegation, with declarative export/import of an agent or Skill as part of a Solution
- Unified AI Gateway: multi-provider routing (Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible/Gemini/local), automatic failover, token budgets, DLP-triggered air-gapping
- Orchestration: deterministic Pipelines (sequential, consensus, peer-review) with human-in-the-loop approval gates and OTLP tracing, schedule/webhook/workflow-fired runs, a real Evaluation Harness, one unified run history
- Chat Assistant with real tool access, including an agent context primer (relationship metadata, get_related_records, get_platform_overview)
- Ranked full-text search over Custom Object records (SQLite FTS5, lexical relevance), plus optional semantic (embedding-based) Vector Search via the workspace's own configured provider (desktop only, no bundled vector database)
- Native Model Context Protocol server (`POST /mcp`, JSON-RPC 2.0) & a companion CLI, both authenticated with the same scoped API keys the REST API uses
- Admin-defined Custom Objects, Custom Relationships, custom fields with validation
- Business Rules and Workflow Automation across any built-in or custom field
- Screen/App Builder (named layouts by role) and custom Dashboards (KPI/chart/record-list widgets)
- App Builder: publish a named app (a hand-built set of objects, screens and a dashboard) with enforced role/user access
- Companies, contacts, opportunities, products, quotes, orders, invoices, contracts, tasks
- Sales dashboards with admin-configurable KPIs, global search, CSV import/export, PDF print output
- Saved Views (named filter/sort/group-by combinations, reusable as a dashboard data source) and Bulk Actions (update status, reassign owner, tag, archive across a multi-select)
- Industry Data Model: a versioned package manifest format, and App Catalog (10 install-ready industry apps)
- Deployment Management: Publishers, versioned Solutions, component export/import, update-with-diff
- Integration Hub: encrypted Connections, OpenAPI Connectors, a generic REST API, HMAC-signed Webhooks, CSV data exchange, scheduled Integration Jobs, unified execution logs

## Product principles

- User ownership of business data
- Offline-first desktop direction
- Connected records instead of duplicated free text
- Simplicity before feature volume
- Open-source transparency
- Modern, accessible product design

## Frequently asked

- Is Lanesra OS free and open source? Yes — MIT-licensed, no licence key, no per-seat pricing.
- Can I self-host it instead of a cloud CRM? Yes — desktop runs fully offline on local SQLite; Team Workspace lets a small team share one instance on their own infrastructure.
- Is it just a CRM? No — the same platform underneath the CRM builds any business app, no code, or installs one of 10 ready-made industry apps, and its own AI agents run directly against that data model.
- Does it have a REST API and webhooks? Yes — the Integration Hub's generic REST API, OpenAPI connectors and HMAC-signed webhooks (desktop edition).
- How do I promote customizations from test to production? Deployment Management: curate a named, versioned Solution, export it, import it into another workspace.
- Does it use embeddings or a vector database for AI? By default, no — free-text search over Custom Object records is ranked lexically (SQLite FTS5's `bm25()`). Desktop can optionally reindex records as real embeddings from its own already-configured OpenAI-compatible or Google Gemini provider (Anthropic has no embeddings API) for a second, meaning-based search ranking alongside it - vectors are plain SQLite BLOBs compared by cosine similarity in Rust, not a bundled vector database, and it's opt-in (Admin → LLM & MCP → Vector Search).
